units: Y. Sabb. I, 4ᵃ top, a. e. אֲכִילַת בן דרוסא (דרוסאי, דור׳) the food Ben D’rosa used to eat, i.e. third done.
<cite ref="Yoma 81a:8">Ib. 81ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>א׳ בכזית</he> wherever <cite ref="A01697"><he>אכל</he></cite> (to eat) is mentioned in the Bible text, the size of an olive is meant.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:6:5">Y. Sot. III, 19ᵇ</cite> top <he>אכילת מזבח</he> the consumption (of sacrifices) on the altar.
<cite ref="Zevachim 31b:2">Zeb. 31ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. <he>א׳ פרס</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01911"><he>פְּרָס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:10">Kil. II, 10</cite>, v. <cite ref="A01704"><he>אָכְלָה</he> II</cite>.—Pl. <he>אֲכִילוֹת</he>.
Gen. R. s. 86, beg. (play on אוכיל Hos. XI, 4) א׳ הרבה (some ed. אוביל—אבילות corr. acc.) purveyances
